d:
Bihar ki rajniti men 'chhote sarkar' ke nam se charchit mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki chhoti beti shivangi ki shahi shadi kisi utsav se kam nahin hone ja rahi hai. 25 navanbar ko hone vale is vivah samaroh men sabse bara aakarshan bhavy ghurdaur pratiyogita hai, jismen kaee rajyon ke karib 200 nami ghore apni raphtar ka jalva bikherenge.
